title: Chat: add start_call permission to SpaceRole vocabulary
description: SpaceRole permissions (line 623-636) have no VTC-related permission. VTC integration requires at least a start_call permission so Spaces can control who initiates calls in channels. Without it, any member can start calls anywhere. One-line addition to the permissions list.
close_reason: Added start_call permission to SpaceRole vocabulary with extensibility clause for companion specs.
